needed.evidence: There is no designated sidewalk or path for pedestrians on the left side of the road, forcing them to walk in the carriageway.
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous sidewalk on the left side of the road to separate pedestrians from motor traffic.

needed.evidence: The narrow pedestrian area on the right is blocked by parked motorcycles and shop extensions.
needed.suggestion: Remove obstructions and enforce parking restrictions to ensure the footway remains clear for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: The edge of the road and the informal path on the right are uneven and broken.
needed.suggestion: Repave the pedestrian area on the right to remove trip hazards and provide a smooth surface.

needed.evidence: There is high pedestrian demand due to the commercial shops on the right, but no designated crossing facility is provided.
needed.suggestion: Install a marked zebra crossing to provide a safe point for pedestrians to cross the road.
